svg.title: Tetrasemaphore NORMATIVE medallion — layered vector master (field + rings + uncut meander with glints + legends en / es + centre mark), slot820
svg.desc: Geometry: meander v3.1 channel outline (meander3.js: rc 8, rf 7, phase 0). Finish: body #B29F7B over the whole footprint with the measured sector sweeps (A axis 83.094°, B axis 307.5°) and zone-gated foil grain (fractalNoise 0.09/print px seed 17; zones seed 23; flecks top ≈2 % @0); then RELATIVE bands clipped to the footprint: rim (0–0.9 px) black @0.65, transition (0.9–2.2 px) black @0.11, ridge (2.2–4.8 px) black @0, centre (inside 4.8 px) black @0.16; highlight cap #F2E4B8. Ink footprint = geometry. Pure vector, deterministic. Fresnel edge (finish6): bands rt opacity x(1-0*max(cos2(theta-83.094),0)); catch-light 0-0.5 px #FFF9E3 @0.3*max(cos2,0). Organic bands (finish7): band group displaced by fractalNoise (0.02/print px, 2 oct, seed 7) scale 2.5 px and blurred σ 0.8 px before the footprint clip; rim as a 0.8 px stroke of the outline (half outside, clipped). Lit edges (build 7, litedge.js, with the bow-tie guard: no strip spans a join turning more than 170 deg): #F2E4B8 on the ridge zone 2.2-4.8 print px inside every edge at opacity 0.65 x max(0, n.L)^2, n = the edge's outward normal, L = (-0.12, -0.993) (sweep A axis toward the top); 11475 vector strips, 65 opacity levels.

g.inkscape:label: 0 field: NORMATIVE tint #181403, the dark ground the colours were chosen against (one lightness and one chroma for all four coins, hue from the coin colour); a disc to r 403.678, its edge under the outer ring; outside the coin stays transparent
1 NORMATIVE rings #D5AF64 (state colour; centre mark #C7B469)
2 meander geometry (ink footprint) with body tone, sweeps, grain
3 gold finish: relative rim / transition / centre bands

3c lit edges (build 7, bow-tie guard: no strip spans a join turning more than 170 deg): the ridge zone 2.2-4.8 print px inside every edge of the ink, #F2E4B8 at 0.65 x max(0, n.L)^2 from each edge's own outward normal n, L = the sweep A axis toward the top (83.094 deg); 11475 strips in 65 opacity levels of 0.01

5a legend plate (en): the stamp cut into the uncut ring, over keys 22-1 (60-120 deg): floor, seams and plate all in the field tint #181403, the same dark as the gaps of the meander; no edge strokes, no shadow; then its window rails on top

5a-rails window rails (en): the seam-fixed cut ring finish/proposals/seam-fix/MASTER-meander-v3.1C-finalA-LEGEND-keys22-1-litedge-guard-slot820.svg clipped to 58.5-121.5 deg, r 306.0-390.0, drawn over the plate so the rails beside the legend are clean rails (with their lit edges, build 7)
2 meander geometry (ink footprint) with body tone, sweeps, grain
3 gold finish: relative rim / transition / centre bands

3c lit edges (build 7, bow-tie guard: no strip spans a join turning more than 170 deg): the ridge zone 2.2-4.8 print px inside every edge of the ink, #F2E4B8 at 0.65 x max(0, n.L)^2 from each edge's own outward normal n, L = the sweep A axis toward the top (83.094 deg); 9622 strips in 65 opacity levels of 0.01

5b legend (en) NORMATIVE: DejaVu Sans Bold 2.34 (file 05-DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf 7e69e81478e233b8), as outlines; cap height 4.4 mm on the channel mid-radius, font size 47.83 slot units = 17.0 pt at 102.785 mm, tracking 1.0; fill #DEC875, flat: no cast shadow, no bevel

5a legend plate (es): the stamp cut into the uncut ring, over keys 22-1 (60-120 deg): floor, seams and plate all in the field tint #181403, the same dark as the gaps of the meander; no edge strokes, no shadow; then its window rails on top

5a-rails window rails (es): the seam-fixed cut ring finish/proposals/seam-fix/MASTER-meander-v3.1C-finalA-LEGEND-keys22-1-litedge-guard-slot820.svg clipped to 58.5-121.5 deg, r 306.0-390.0, drawn over the plate so the rails beside the legend are clean rails (with their lit edges, build 7)
2 meander geometry (ink footprint) with body tone, sweeps, grain
3 gold finish: relative rim / transition / centre bands

3c lit edges (build 7, bow-tie guard: no strip spans a join turning more than 170 deg): the ridge zone 2.2-4.8 print px inside every edge of the ink, #F2E4B8 at 0.65 x max(0, n.L)^2 from each edge's own outward normal n, L = the sweep A axis toward the top (83.094 deg); 9622 strips in 65 opacity levels of 0.01

5b legend (es) NORMATIVO: DejaVu Sans Bold 2.34 (file 05-DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf 7e69e81478e233b8), as outlines; cap height 4.4 mm on the channel mid-radius, font size 47.83 slot units = 17.0 pt at 102.785 mm, tracking 1.0; fill #DEC875, flat: no cast shadow, no bevel; Spanish set of 2026-10-05: NORMATIVO / INFORMATIVO / CRÍTICO / METACOGNITIVO

4a glyph placement: I centred (410,410); diamond drawn as ONE outline plus the shared line, sharp joins (one point at each side vertex); triangle side and stroke as the CRITICAL triangles, the whole mark scaled 0.9478 about the centre (0.575388 x 0.9478 = 0.545353) so its outer symmetry marks stay as far from the ring as the CRITICAL triangle points; I twice, the lower the mirror of the upper, 14.71 mm tall; V4 operator = identity
4 I: the identity; Fix(I) is every point, so the whole glyph carries the Fix gold

6 symmetry marks: two bars across each mirror line of the mark at both ends (4.0 x 0.9 mm; the first 1.5 mm beyond the mark, then 1.6 mm, then the second), the coin colour; the drafting convention for a line of symmetry (ISO 128-3), proportions ours
